description: This file defines the `CalendarActivity` class, which models calendar-related activities such as tasks, meetings, and calls within the SuiteCRM platform. It includes methods for constructing activity instances, generating SQL WHERE clauses for date range queries, and handling free/busy activity retrieval based on vCal data.

classes.name: CalendarActivity
classes.description: Represents calendar activities such as tasks, meetings, and calls. Provides methods for initializing activity objects, generating SQL clauses for date-based queries, and retrieving free/busy data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a CalendarActivity object based on a task, call, or free/busy slots provided as arguments.

methods.name: get_occurs_within_where_clause
methods.description: Returns a SQL WHERE clause to find activities occurring within a specific date range.

methods.name: get_occurs_until_where_clause
methods.description: Returns a SQL WHERE clause to find activities until a specific date.

methods.name: get_freebusy_activities
methods.description: Fetches free/busy activities for a user within a specified date range from vCal data.

methods.name: get_activities
methods.description: Retrieves calendar activities for a user within a specified date range, applying filters for tasks, calls, and completion status.
